## Quarto

Quarto enables you to weave together content and executable code into a finished document. To learn more about Quarto see <https://quarto.org>.

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(palmerpenguins)

bill_summary <- penguins |>
  filter(!is.na(bill_length_mm)) |>          # drop missing values
  group_by(species) |>
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    avg_bill_length_mm = round(mean(bill_length_mm), 1),
    sd_bill_length_mm  = round(sd(bill_length_mm), 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(bill_summary)

ggplot(penguins, aes(x = species, y = bill_length_mm, fill = species)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.4, size = 1.5) +   # optional points
  labs(
    title = "Bill Length by Penguin Species",
    x = "Species",
    y = "Bill Length (mm)",
    fill = "Species"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```
